fullPassage: It was early October, and the weather couldn't have been better for hiking. Ryan slowly followed the mountain path, listening to the soft sounds of the forest around him. The afternoon sunlight felt warm on his skin, and he paused now and then, enjoying the quiet peace of being alone. Leaves moved lightly in the gentle wind, and he felt pleased far away from his usual worries. Then, he heard a strange sound behind him. He turned quickly and looked around. He didn't see anything, but he was certain he had heard something. And it wasn't the blowing of the wind or the falling of a twig. Someone — or something — was moving nearby. A sudden chill went through him, and his heart began beating fast.

questions.stem:

[주어진 문장] He turned quickly and looked around.

① The afternoon sunlight felt warm on his skin. ② He felt pleased far away from his usual worries. ③ Then, he heard a strange sound behind him. ④ He didn't see anything, but he was certain he had heard something.

det.korean: 이상한 소리를 들은(③) 직후 빠르게 돌아보는(주어진 문장) 행동이 자연스럽다. 그 뒤 아무것도 보이지 않았다(④).
det.analysis:
✅ ③ ③번 뒤: 소리를 들은 직후 돌아보는 반응 → 문장 흐름: 소리 들음 → 돌아봄 → 아무것도 안 보임
❌ ① 너무 이른 위치
❌ ② 소리를 듣기 전 감정 묘사 뒤 — 자연스럽지 않음
❌ ④ 이미 돌아본 후 상황 묘사
det.tip: 문장 삽입: 원인(소리) → 반응(돌아봄) → 결과(아무것도 못 봄) 논리 흐름.

questions.stem:
다음 문장 (A), (B), (C)를 문맥에 맞게 배열한 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

(A) A sudden chill went through him, and his heart began beating fast.
(B) Then, he heard a strange sound behind him and turned quickly.
(C) Ryan enjoyed the quiet peace of the forest, feeling pleased far from his worries.

det.korean: C(평화로운 시작) → B(이상한 소리 들음) → A(공포 반응) 순서가 지문의 흐름.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ (C) - (B) - (A): 평온 → 소리 → 공포 반응의 논리적 순서
❌ ① (A)가 먼저 오면 공포가 원인 없이 시작됨
❌ ② (B)로 시작하면 배경 설명 없음
❌ ④ (C)-(A)-(B): 소리보다 공포 반응이 먼저 올 수 없음
det.tip: 심경변화 글의 구조: 배경/평화 → 전환점(사건) → 감정 반응.

다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 영어 단어를 쓰시오.

갑작스러운 냉기가 그를 관통했다.
→ A sudden _______ went through him.
questions.passage: It was early October, and the weather couldn't have been better for hiking. Ryan slowly followed the mountain path, listening to the soft sounds of the forest around him. The afternoon sunlight felt warm on his skin, and he paused now and then, enjoying the quiet peace of being alone. Leaves moved lightly in the gentle wind, and he felt pleased far away from his usual worries. Then, he heard a strange sound behind him. He turned quickly and looked around. He didn't see anything, but he was certain he had heard something. And it wasn't the blowing of the wind or the falling of a twig. Someone — or something — was moving nearby. A sudden chill went through him, and his heart began beating fast.

det.korean: chill = 냉기, 오한. 공포 반응.
det.analysis: 지문 'A sudden chill went through him' 직접 확인.
det.tip: chill = 냉기/오한. go through = 관통하다.
